version.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to skill features or logic.
- Documentation and reporting guidelines remain unchanged.

llm.summary: This is a straightforward code-review skill that tells the agent to inspect repository changes and report findings without changing code.

dimensions.detail: Repository file reads and grep-style caller tracing are proportionate for code review. There are no instructions to access unrelated local data, credentials, network resources, or external services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only a single Markdown skill file with frontmatter metadata. No bundled scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or executable files were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The fallback scope is clear: review named changes, otherwise uncommitted changes or the last commit, and produce a structured report. It explicitly says it lists findings and changes no code.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, tool wrapping, memory writes, or mutation authority is requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is quality review of a diff, and its instructions focus on reading the relevant diff, touched code, callers, tests, and README to identify bugs, security risks, scale issues, missing tests, speed problems, and unnecessary code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an opinionated code-review workflow. It will cause the agent to read relevant repository files and diffs, which is expected for review, but it does not instruct the agent to modify files or perform hidden actions.
